notes: fact: Pires gives a February departure from Bengal, a month at sea, and an early August departure from Melaka; Araújo gives April in and September out (Pires I, p. 93; Cartas III, p. 10). See docs/research/monsoon-calendar.md, §2.
inference: Early March is reconstructed from Pires's travel time; the April weight preserves the alternative chronology. See docs/research/monsoon-calendar.md, §2.
gameplay: Relative weights and month preferences are authored tuning, not observed traffic or compulsory departure dates.
